errors.evidence: The description states there are 27 countries and provides a list of 26. The chart actually displays 28 countries; the list omits Гърция (Greece) and Хърватия (Croatia).
The bars are not in a random order; they are sorted in descending order of their value from left to right.
The range of values is incorrect. The highest value (Denmark) is approximately 0.98, and the lowest value (Romania) is approximately 0.76. The stated range of 0.6 to 0.9 is inaccurate.
The vertical axis has numerical markers (0, 0.2, 0.4, etc.) but does not have a descriptive text label.
